card.title: Announcements
card.description: Optional signed notices from the Levelrail project, shown in the dashboard.
card.allHint: Security, features, maintenance and the newsletter.
card.newsletterHint: A quiet list on the Announcements page.
card.urlHint: An https URL for a mirror you host. Signatures are still checked against keys built into this release.
card.intervalHint: Set with the updates.announcements_interval runtime setting.
card.revealsBody: Each check downloads one public file. GitHub sees your instance's IP address, the time, and the standard TLS and User-Agent details of a Go HTTP client. The request carries no query string, no cookie, no instance id, no version number and no counts. Which notices apply to you is decided on your instance. Nothing is fetched while the feed is off.
